written.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a more capable frontier AI model not yet released
written.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model that improves coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity but is not publicly available. The model shows a “significant leap” in vulnerability detection and scores 89 points higher on WebDev Arena, ranking fourth.

written.headline: Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2 speech dataset
written.summary: Nvidia unveiled Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, a 30‑billion‑parameter open‑weight model that can transcribe audio in up to 40 languages, translate 31 languages, and distinguish up to eight speakers. It also released Granary v2, an expanded open‑source multilingual speech dataset.

written.headline: Meta plans up to $100 billion equity raise to fund AI infrastructure
written.summary: Meta Platforms announced a series of equity offerings totaling up to $100 billion to finance its AI data‑center expansion, including $22.5 billion of Class A common stock, $12.5 billion of mandatory convertible preferred stock, and a potential $60 billion at‑the‑market program. Chipmakers Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom have indicated non‑binding interest in buying up to $5 billion of the common stock.
